steps.action: Tap '+ Add enquiry'
user_sees: Sheet titled 'Add enquiry'
Boxes 'Name', 'Code', 'Mobile number', 'Interested in (optional)', 'Where did they hear about us? (optional)' (showing 'Not asked'), 'Follow-up date'
Quick day buttons under the date
Buttons 'Cancel' and 'Save enquiry'
must_not: The button usable with the internet off

steps.action: Type a name and a 10-digit number, pick a quick day
user_sees: Under the date: 'Call back on <day> (<how far>)'
must_not: The quick day not shown as picked

steps.action: Tap 'Save enquiry'
user_sees: The button reads 'Saving…' and cannot be pressed
The sheet closes
The new row is in the list for its day
must_not: Two rows from one press
The sheet closing when the save failed

start: The Add enquiry sheet opened straight away by another screen, and the button inside the empty list

steps.action: Arrive on Enquiries from a shortcut that starts adding
user_sees: Enquiries opens with the 'Add enquiry' sheet already open
must_not: The sheet opening again by itself after it is closed

steps.action: In a gym with no enquiries, close the sheet and read the list
user_sees: 'No enquiries yet'
'When someone walks in or calls to ask about joining, add them here with a day to call back.'
A '+ Add enquiry' button inside the empty list
must_not: A blank card

start: Add enquiry sheet; one open enquiry and one member already use known numbers

steps.action: Leave the name empty, tap 'Save enquiry'
user_sees: Under Name: 'Type their name.'
must_not: An enquiry saved with no name

steps.action: Type a follow-up date before today, save
user_sees: Under the date: 'The follow-up date can’t be in the past.'
must_not: A past call-back day saved

steps.action: Type the number of an open enquiry
user_sees: A warning line: '<name> already asked from this number (call back <day>). You can still save.'
must_not: The save blocked
No warning at all

steps.action: Type the number of a member
user_sees: A warning line: '<member's name> is already a member with this number.'
must_not: The warning naming a member of another gym

steps.action: Type more letters in Interested in than allowed, save
user_sees: Under the box: 'Use at most <n> letters.'
must_not: The text cut and saved without a word

start: Add enquiry sheet with a name and number typed

steps.action: Tap 'Cancel'
user_sees: The sheet closes; no new row
must_not: A half-saved enquiry

steps.action: Open the sheet again, type the same person, clear the date
user_sees: Under the date: 'No date: it goes under Later.'
must_not: The values typed before still in the boxes as if saved

steps.action: Tap 'Save enquiry' while the save cannot reach the server, then tap it again when it can
user_sees: A red line in the sheet with the reason; the typed values stay
After the second press the sheet closes and one row is in the later list
must_not: Two rows after the second press
The typed values lost on the failed save

start: Add enquiry sheet; the person is not a member and has not used any MettleUp page

steps.action: Save the enquiry with name, number and what they want
user_sees: The row on Enquiries for the owner and the front desk of this gym
must_not: The person sent any message by MettleUp because they were added
The row visible to another gym or branch

steps.action: Look for a way to remove the person from the list
user_sees: 'Not interested' closes the enquiry; the name and number stay on the not-interested list
must_not: The name and number shown anywhere a member can see
